verdict.rationale: Productboard exposes a REST API that can be used to read and extract feedback, customers, and product data programmatically (productboard-docs-1, productboard-docs-4), which implicitly enables data portability, but there is no explicit documentation of a full data export feature, open-format bulk export, or account closure/data takeout process. missing for 10: dedicated export-all-data feature, explicit open format (CSV/JSON) export documentation, data portability/GDPR export statement, confirmation that API coverage is complete enough to reconstruct 100% of a workspace's data.
